request.text:
labels: Beside a corridor wall, one student's palm rests on the wall above the other student's shoulder, leaving both bodies, the wall contact and the gap between their faces visible.; 복도 벽 옆에서 한 학생의 손바닥이 상대 어깨 위 벽에 놓이고 두 몸과 벽 접촉 및 얼굴 사이 간격이 함께 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: Beside a corridor wall, one student's palm rests on the wall above the other student's shoulder, leaving both bodies, the wall contact and the gap between their faces visible.
aliases: 벽 짚기의 공간 관계
